Hi Jacob — great notes, thanks. Quick follow-up and expected next steps from our side:

Summary of what I heard:
- Baseline 15 TPS, peak 40 TPS (bursts ~5–10 minutes)
- Concurrency target 8–20
- Avg tokens: prompt 120 / response 350 (~470 total per request)
- Latency SLO p50 <200ms, p95 <400ms
- Considering Llama-2-13B (q4) or Mistral-7B

Sizing guidance (initial estimate):
- GPU recommendation: H100 80GB preferred for headroom and lower p95 at higher concurrency; A100 80GB is plausible if we use more nodes + aggressive quantization.
- For Llama-2-13B (quantized q4) on H100:~ 6–8 GPUs to comfortably hit sustained 15 TPS with room for bursts; to cover 40 TPS peak with headroom and autoscale, plan for a capacity pool of 12–14 GPUs with burst policy.
- For Mistral-7B on H100:~ 4–6 GPUs baseline, 8–10 GPUs for peak.
- Concurrency considerations: we'll configure multi-model partitions and request routing to keep p95 targets; recommend target max concurrency per GPU of ~6–8 for 13B models when not aggressively batched.

Cost/contracting note: We can provide Reserved (Dedicated) pricing for a 12-month commit vs monthly burst capacity. I attached a quick mutual action plan (MAP) template and the token profile you sent.

Next steps:
1) Rafael and I will run a quick perf sim with your sample token profile and send a node-count + monthly cost estimate by EOD 2026-10-05.
2) Jacob / Priya: confirm preferred model (Llama-2-13B or Mistral-7B) and whether strict isolation (Private VPC) is required for procurement.
3) Schedule a 30-min sizing review (suggest 2026-10-06 or 10-07).

Marissa / Aditya — starting perf sims now with the token profile Jacob provided. Notes from my initial pass:
- Using two model configs: Llama-2-13B (q4) and Mistral-7B (q4) on H100 80GB nodes.
- Simulation assumptions: avg total tokens/request = 470, 80% of traffic is chat generation, 20% embeddings/shorter calls.
- Batching: we'll model a hybrid approach — low-latency tail for interactive traffic (small batch sizes 1–4) and background batching for lower-priority requests.

Preliminary capacity estimates (subject to sim results):
- Llama-2-13B (H100): baseline pool 8 GPUs -> sustained ~18 TPS, p95 ~350–380ms; burst pool to 14 GPUs -> peak ~44 TPS.
- Mistral-7B (H100): baseline pool 5 GPUs -> sustained ~20 TPS; burst to 9 GPUs -> peak ~48 TPS; better cost/TPS but slightly higher p50 variability under adversarial seq lengths.

If FintechCo needs strict p95 < 300ms at 40 TPS, we'd suggest adding lightweight caching (prefix/KV) and favoring H100 over A100. A100 will work but requires more GPUs and tighter quantization; call that ~20% more nodes for the same TPS.

I'll attach the perf run artifacts and a short node-count table once sims complete. Planning to have the full estimates and a recommended config by EOD Monday (2026-10-05).

-Rafael
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
